interventions: Started the supplied fixture with python3; it bound only to 127.0.0.1 and printed dynamic port 53272.
Used the escalation path only for the local fixture bind and Veritas runs against 127.0.0.1:53272; the app manifest grants only 127.0.0.1.
The coordinator supplied the fixture location and endpoint paths because they were not present in the brief.
failures: The default sandbox blocked the fixture bind and the first Veritas network run; both succeeded after loopback-only escalation.
An unsupported timeout_seconds manifest field was rejected; changed to the documented timeout_ms field.
The first veritas new --help invocation created a --help scaffold directory; it was removed immediately.
Early speculative API and map-literal syntax attempts failed compilation; the final source passes check and build.

recommendation.reason: The app uses the Python-free native HTTP, JSON, file, and bounded-parallel APIs and requires no third-party packages.
recommendation.observed_user_benefit: A four-worker cap, a 1500 ms manifest timeout, and a 127.0.0.1-only host grant are explicit; malformed and 503 feeds do not discard valid quotes; output stays deterministic and the day filter preserves feed counts.
recommendation.material_regressions: API discoverability cost time: the README named capabilities but not all signatures, so the product reference and compiler diagnostics were needed. No direct Python comparison was run in this builder session.

limitations: No direct Python implementation was built in this blinded builder session; the recommendation reflects the observed Veritas workflow and user-facing behavior.
